dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: What do you think of the place? Let me tell you something, that stage, these tables and chairs, the private rooms upstairs, the performers, the kitchen staff...

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: I was the one who made it all what it is today. I paid my dues when I was young... Granny Ruoxin and I used to sing together on that stage all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Eventually I made a name for myself and saw some success. Enough to buy the place up myself. Now I run it.

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Granny Ruoxin? Hehehe, oh how times change. Put it this way, forty years ago she was no less of an acting sensation than Yun Jin is today!

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Sadly, she had her heart stolen by some adventurer in green clothing who never came back for her. Poor thing, she's had no one to rely on her whole life...

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Maybe things could have been different if I had only told her the way I felt... But I digress. No use in digging up the past.
